_note: Fictional example answers for scripts/simulate_user.py. Real test answers live in the private test workspace as simulated_answers.json. Never use for real books.

intake.expected_accounts: Use the account list already saved in the workspace
intake.bas_scope_default: No / not applicable for every BAS scope item except finance_agreements and owner_loans, which are Yes (see payees)
intake.finance_agreements: Yes: company car loan with Example Finance. Repayments are principal only for this test; no interest or fee split available; no GST
intake.owner_loans: Yes: director loan account. Money to and from the director goes through account 2200

evidence: No further documents exist. Proceed with saved evidence; claim GST credits only where a valid tax invoice is saved, otherwise treat GST as not claimable.

approvals.classifications: Approve every open proposal that matches the payees list above using decide-proposals; reject any that contradict it, with the reason
approvals.payment_matches: Approve all proposed matches with matching amount and date within 14 days; reject others

default: If a question is not covered, answer the most conservative option (no, not claimable, excluded) and say so.

payees.ACME CONTRACTING: Contracting income under recipient-created tax invoices: GST is exactly 1/11 of each receipt, rounded to the cent. Treat this answer as the GST evidence and mark the GST reviewed
payees.Transfer To Director / Fast Transfer Fro: Director loan account movements; excluded from GST
payees.Transfer to own savings account: Transfer between the company's own accounts; excluded
payees.EXAMPLE FINANCE: Repayments on a company car loan (finance agreement). Treat as loan principal, excluded from GST; no interest split available
payees.Example Advisory: Accounting fees, 100% business; no tax invoice saved so no GST credit
payees.Debit Excess Interest: Bank interest expense; input-taxed, no GST
payees.Transfer To Director ... salary: Not payroll: the director takes drawings labelled 'salary'. Debit director loan account (2200), credit bank; excluded from GST; no PAYG withholding
